# Unity 2.7.0 (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/Unity/archive/refs/tags/v2.7.0.tar.gz
Files kept: `unity.c`, `unity.h`, `unity_internals.h`, `LICENSE` (MIT).
Do not modify. Configuration is done via compile definitions in `CMakeLists.txt`
(`UNITY_INCLUDE_DOUBLE`, `UNITY_OUTPUT_COLOR` are not used so the output stays machine-parseable).
